description: Build the least-privilege hardening plan for workflows under a repo path without writing any files. For each job, infers the permissions its steps actually need (checkout is contents: read, release creation is contents: write, GHCR push is packages: write, PR comments are pull-requests: write, and so on) and returns a paste-ready permissions block per job plus a top-level union block, with notes where a grant is removed or a privileged trigger shape needs a human decision.

path.description: Repo root, a .github/workflows directory, or a single workflow file

name: harden_plan
